summary: Iteration 6 (Mi Ludoteca): verified new retry-on-transient-error logic in runAIFlow and full regression. Frontend code inspection confirmed postWithRetry (App.js lines 491-511) inside runAIFlow: on 404/502/503/504/ECONNABORTED/timeout/Network Error, it waits 2s and retries POST /api/identify-game exactly once. E2E via preview URL (https://repo-restore-9.preview.emergentagent.com): opened 'Añadir Juego', uploaded /tmp/marabunta.jpg, IA modal (data-testid='ia-modal') appeared, reached data-testid='ia-status-choosing' with BGG candidate 'Marabunta' (BGG ID 403265). No 'Error 404' text present. Backend regression pytest: 51/51 passed (identify-game normalization, IA/BGG endpoints, games CRUD, categorization/subestilo/interacción, expansions, backup/restore).
critical_code_review_comments: Retry logic is duplicated conceptually with the timeout config; consider extracting into a small util (postJsonWithRetry) so the same behaviour applies to future endpoints without copy/paste.
App.js is 2902 lines. Extracting the IA/BGG flow (runAIFlow, error mapping, retry) into a shared hook remains recommended.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing /tmp/marabunta.jpg. No games persisted (modal closed before final save).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retry-once (2s) on transient errors is in place in runAIFlow. E2E flow with a real board-game photo reliably reaches 'choosing' via the public preview URL. Backend is fully green (51 tests). If the user still reports 'Error 404 del servidor', ask them to hard-reload (stale bundle) since the new build always retries once before showing that message.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous complaint was caused by a transient 404 while the backend was hot-reloading. Iteration 6 fix (postWithRetry with 2s delay, single retry on 404/502/503/504/timeout/Network Error) hides the transient window from the user. Verified: real-image E2E succeeded end-to-end.
